class.name: curobov2_ros_rviz/CuroboPanel
class.description: Unified curobo panel: ONE dock, laid out like MoveIt's Motion Planning panel, with five tabs. Context (planning group / planner node, trajectory type, control strategy, world representation), Planning (goal state, planning request, and a Clear / Compute / Execute / Cancel button row), Joints (live joint-state monitor plus joint-space planning, its target cell a draggable progress bar exactly as in MoveIt), Manipulation (MoveIt's own object-perception grid, with its controls absent because curobo has no perception services) and Scene Objects (MoveIt's two columns: the server-side object list from get_scene_objects, the add / remove form, and the object status line). This is the only curobo planner panel: the planner-args panel it reuses as its Planning tab is deliberately not registered separately, so it cannot be added as a dock of its own. The task constructor stays a separate panel: it is a different workflow, not part of this planner's UI.

class.name: curobov2_ros_rviz/TargetDisplay
class.description: Generic 6-DOF target marker; all planner/MPC logic lives in the Curobo panel, on its Planning tab.

class.name: curobov2_ros_rviz/SparseVoxelGridDisplay

class.name: curobov2_ros_rviz/CuroboTrajectoryDisplay
class.description: Visualise a cuRobo JointTrajectory as an animated full-robot model with optional ghost trail.

class.name: curobov2_ros_rviz/ReachabilityMapDisplay
